meta.note: Pairs confirmed as synonyms that the source lists miss. Each pair is linked in the synonym graph, so neither word is ever offered as a wrong option for the other's group. a and b are stable graph node ids: a plain spelling, "<entryId>.0" for an entry's headword, or "<firstItemId>.<senseKey>" for a sense of a senses.json split (validate:data prints them with readable labels such as מתוח#tense). They never depend on hint text.
